steps.title: Inspect Manifest Configuration
steps.description: Analyze AndroidManifest.xml for correct namespace definitions and element attributes.

steps.title: Fix Activity Declaration
steps.description: Ensure the MainActivity is properly declared with the correct android:name attribute.

steps.title: Resolve Intent Filter Attributes
steps.description: Verify and fix action and category names within the intent-filter of MainActivity.

steps.title: Remove Unallowed External Dependencies
steps.description: Clean app build.gradle dependencies to remove external nanohttpd dependency in compliance with project rules.

steps.title: Configure Build SDK Versions
steps.description: Set and verify compileSdkVersion, minSdkVersion, and targetSdkVersion to 34, 21, and 34 respectively.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Toolchain compatibility
steps.description: Configure Java compatibility to VERSION_1_8 in compilation options.

steps.title: Clean MainActivity Java Source
steps.description: Verify MainActivity is fully clean and properly inflates the correct main layout.

steps.title: Verify Layout XML file
steps.description: Ensure activity_main.xml contains correct layout elements and has no validation errors.

steps.title: Validate Metadata and Package Matching
steps.description: Ensure app-meta.json corresponds perfectly with build.gradle and MainActivity package names.

steps.title: Building Compile Fail Demo
steps.description: Assemble the project to verify successful generation of the debug APK.
